questions.question: What is source reduction?
choices: Preventing waste before it is created
Burning every discarded material
Mixing all waste into one container
Moving waste to a different landfill

questions.question: What is pre-consumer waste?
choices: Products discarded by households after use
Material discarded during production before a product reaches its consumer
Only litter collected from streets
Only materials discarded after many years of use

questions.question: What is a main role of a materials recovery facility?
choices: Extracting new metal ores from mines
Manufacturing every finished product sold to consumers
Sorting collected recyclable materials for further processing

questions.question: What is composting?
choices: Melting plastic into metal
Separating salts through nuclear decay
Turning every waste into glass
Managed biological decomposition of suitable organic material

questions.question: What is leachate in a landfill?
choices: Liquid that has passed through waste and carries dissolved or suspended material
Only dry gas released from waste
Solid metal sorted from refuse
Clean rainwater before contact with waste

questions.question: Which gas can be produced by anaerobic decomposition of organic waste?
choices: Helium
Methane
Neon
Argon

questions.question: What does a product life-cycle assessment examine?
choices: Only the product's sale price
Only the color of its packaging
Impacts across stages from resource extraction through end of use
Only the day the product is purchased

questions.question: Why is preventing unnecessary waste often prioritized over recycling it?

Every discarded material can be recycled indefinitely without losses

Composting

choices: Automatic conversion of every item into compost

choices: Only the impacts after the consumer throws it away
